label: Thriller
context_hint: Tense, suspenseful atmosphere. High-contrast lighting with sharp shadows, unsettling angles (low-angle, Dutch tilt, tight framing). Build dread through composition — obscured faces, negative space, silhouettes, half-lit rooms. Colors lean cold and desaturated except for isolated accents (a red light, a single lamp). Pacing implies danger is imminent; the viewer should feel something is about to happen. This is a mood and lighting filter, not a plot instruction — if the narrative direction is calm or mundane, keep the moment calm, just lit and framed with this tension (a shadow falling wrong, an accent color, an off-kilter angle); reserve running/fleeing/flinching for when the narrative direction actually describes danger or urgency.
